}}'''Nazar Kurenin''' was born in [[Malkier]] but grew up in [[Kandor]].

== Appearance ==
He was jut-nosed. His white hair was cut short and wore a forked beard. He was twice [[Lan Mandragoran]]'s age and was past his seventieth year. He once again wore the ''[[hadori]]''.

== History ==
He used to be a baker but considers himself a [[Borderlander]] first.

== Activities ==
He walks in front of Lan and [[Bukama Marenellin]] while they are in [[Canluum]].

More than twenty years later, Nazar, [[Andere]] and [[Rakim]] all meet up with Lan and [[Bulen]] along the [[Plain of Lances]]. They travel in front of Lan until he finally accepts them into his company. Lan catches sight of Nazar hiding the [[Golden Crane]] in his saddlebag but lets him keep it rather than tearing it up.

== Death ==
Nazar dies during Lan's initial skirmishes against the [[Trolloc]]s at [[Tarwin's Gap]].
